flow: Read exact canonical task/completion and linked mapping from a valid cloud journal; reject archived tasks, unsupported kinds, restored/corrected sources and all unresolved cross-tool effects or active executor ownership.

Derive companion-completion-score-v1 from the original confirmed completeTask entry and exact scoreUp effect index; select the retained dispatched journal attempt token and verify Auth scoreReceipt against the full source binding and remote identity/fingerprint. Legacy or absent proof is unavailable.

Prepare an idempotent request-bound source/context review using Auth inspectRecovery. Bind current verified account, task/mapping/completion/source proof, expected revision and expiring Auth review. All resource estimates remain unknown.

Accept only the exact reviewed command ID under current scopes/consent/gates, epoch and native revision. Reserve a durable original Auth recoverTask request before send and hold a dedicated canonical document fence. Unknown state keeps the fence and permits receipt lookup only.

Only the original successful recoverTask receipt permits one native restoration/occurrence correction and a retained linked recovery receipt in the same canonical commit. No re-score, reward refund claim, schedule change, next occurrence or party management.

Get/recover reads preserve original arguments/attempt timestamp and never redispatch after uncertainty. Already known receipts remain readable; account/grant changes cannot authorize a replacement action. Native recovery finalization stays tied to the original approved source and known receipt.
plannedStorage: Dedicated workspace_linked_recoveries action table and linked_recovery_fence with a document-update trigger; same original-ID commit can finalize. No remote migration or activation in this task.
plannedCanonicalExtension: Optional LinkedTaskRecoveries receipt records with exact source proof, original down attempt and review. Existing TaskRestoration or OccurrenceCorrection stores the causal native transition; typed validators require the paired receipt and zero new projection effects.
limits: No live score/Cron, deployment, device operation or commit
Legacy/expired/unknown original score proof stays unavailable
Habitica has no cross-client conditional score transaction; final external race remains explicit
remaining: D1 action orchestration/fence and lifecycle integration
Reviewed MCP and typed browser adapters
